messages:
anya: quick heads-up: adding `probe_snapshot` to route config so we can shadow-route quota changes and capture small sanitized samples. snippet: 

```yaml
route:
  id: "priority-route"
  probe_snapshot:
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 0.01
    snapshot_bucket: "s3://redwood-probe-snapshots"
```

brian: sgtm. please emit metrics: `probe.sampled`, `probe.failures`, `probe.p99_delta_ms`. also need a tiny dashboard card (last 1h success rate + sparkline). @devex can you take it?

devex: yep. card will include status, sample_rate, last_sample_time, link to pre-signed sample list and a replay button that opens traces with probe id filter.

carol: rollout plan? abort criteria?

anya: plan: dry-run shadow at 1% for 2h, canary 5% for 30m, then 25% -> 100%. abort if error-rate delta >0.5% or p99 increase >50ms. gate passes after >=99.8% success for 1h.

brian: add `X-Probe-Id` header on sampled requests so we can correlate sample -> trace. also snapshot files should include that id.

anya: will add header and S3 snapshot metadata. ops-bot: kicked off dry-run job id `dryrun-1766667890`

ops-bot: DRY-RUN (summary 2h): sampled 3,210 requests, failures 1 (0.031%), p99 +7ms. no abort triggers. snapshots uploaded to s3://redwood-probe-snapshots/1766667890/

devex: mocked the card in staging: https://staging.redwood/console/cards/1766667890 - shows samples link and replay action.

carol: thanks all. anya ping when PR is up so ops can review snapshots and metrics.

anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4921  contains schema, validation, and header. landing after reviews.

brian: lgtm, please add grafana panel json to the docs.

anya: will do. thanks!
